# DSH Studio v0.9.0

This release strengthens recovery, portable configuration, plugin review and parallel work while preserving existing
Profiles, sessions and update paths. It also fixes renderer recovery after an in-place 0.8.0 upgrade and keeps LAN
remote sessions usable across transient Harness restarts.

## Added

- **Isolated Safe Mode.** A Studio-owned recovery Profile rebuilds only the official base and web layers. It never
  adopts an unmarked user Profile and never changes the selected Profile.
- **Portable `.dshpreset` packages.** Presets have a versioned manifest, per-file SHA-256 verification, bounded paths
  and sizes, an import preview, collision refusal and atomic activation. Only user-authored files are exported.
- **Plugin trust and resource evidence.** Review now includes runtime compatibility, registry integrity, canonical
  repository identity, lifecycle scripts, deprecation, dependency count, unpacked size and native-build declarations.
- **Git Worktree Manager.** Studio discovers native worktrees, creates collision-safe branch worktrees and can reveal
  or switch to each isolated workspace without mixing agent changes.
- **Reversible session archive.** Studio persists a bounded archive index without editing or deleting the Harness-owned
  append-only logs, and corrupted archive metadata degrades to an empty index.

## Changed and secured

- LAN remote access suspends while Harness is unavailable and resumes on the same address and port with the same
  in-memory device credentials. Explicit Close still revokes all credentials and prevents an automatic reopen.
- Process output, editable runtime documents, registry helpers, plugin imports, profile paths, network downloads and
  gateway traffic now have explicit ownership, size and lifetime bounds.
- Profile rename/delete, cross-window mutations and runtime-module materialization are transactional and reject linked
  or oversized inputs instead of partially changing a Profile.

## Fixed and polished

- Fixed an in-place 0.7.8/0.8.0 upgrade opening an empty desktop surface when the saved presentation needed Harness
  but Harness was stopped. The local Workbench remains available while the saved presentation preference is retained.
- Fixed lazy startup chunk failures leaving a blank page or reload loop. Native startup recovery is generation-safe,
  rearms after a failed load and falls back to a visible renderer error surface.
- Fixed concurrent atomic replacement on Windows intermittently failing with access or sharing violations while
  another writer, Defender or an indexer was releasing the destination. Retries are bounded to those transient errors.
- Fixed terminal, listener, update-installer, bridge, catalog and child-process lifecycle races that could retain a
  stale handle, restore an old response or leave work running after cancellation.

## Install and update

Version 0.9.0 is an in-place upgrade from the public 0.8.0 release. Existing `~/.dsh` Profiles, plugins, workspaces,
sessions and credentials are preserved. Verify assets with `SHA256SUMS.txt`; in-app updates still require a valid
Tauri updater signature. Windows, Linux and macOS assets are built from the same tag.

No Apple device is currently available. macOS Intel, Apple Silicon and Universal assets are compiled, unit-tested,
headless-booted with the full runtime and updater-signature checked, but Gatekeeper, VoiceOver and installer flows are
not claimed as physical-device validated. OS publisher-signing status depends on final public-asset inspection.
